title: Equidimensionality of catenary Noetherian local S2 rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof separates maximal-dimensional from lower-dimensional irreducible components and chooses a generic intersection point. Catenarity forces a local dimension at least two, while S2 forces depth at least two; the resulting punctured spectrum is disconnected, contradicting depth-two connectedness. The geometric contradiction is more than a routine dimension formula.
